title: MotionByDk AE Workflow Pro v3.9.0 — Major Update
message: Shape Tools Suite Redesign, 1-Click Quick Shapes, Gradient Studio & Presets Dropdown, and 3D Carousel X/Y/Z Axis & Sphere Upgrades.
changelog: Shape Tools Suite Redesign: Compact, collapsible, and fully responsive UI for docked & pop-out panels
1-Click Quick Shapes: Instantly create Square, Rounded, Circle, Star, Triangle, and Line shape layers with auto Fill & Stroke
Gradient Studio & Presets: New Presets dropdown, custom saved presets, live Start/End color swatches, Hex & Eyedropper
3D Carousel Upgrades: Single-select X, Y, Z Auto-Rotate axis, fixed 3D Sphere top/bottom rotation & 3D Ring Auto-Rotate
Bug Fixes: Fixed Star/Triangle Fill & Stroke, Gradient/Solid switching, slider sensitivity, and pop-out responsiveness
